title: Capital Provisioning & USDC Source Fix
task: Bot was finding gems but zero trades were executing on Base/Arbitrum

what_went_well: Systematic diagnosis: logs → routing → execution → identified 3 blockers
Created capital_provisioner.py for auto ETH→USDC conversion
Fixed USDC threshold from $25 to $5 in wallet_router.py
what_went_wrong: Wrong env var names initially (PRIVATE_KEY_PRIMARY vs WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY_PRIMARY)
Capital Preservation Mode was blocking ALL trades with stale $1,097 floor
risk.py fell back to native ETH when USDC < position size, but Base tokens have no ETH liquidity
root_causes: BLOCKER 1: DailyFloorGuardian floor was $1,097 (stale from when positions were open) vs $259 current → all entries blocked
BLOCKER 2: risk.py line 192: if usdc_balance < position_size * 0.95, fallback to native ETH. But 1inch returned INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY because Base tokens only pair with USDC
BLOCKER 3: wallet_router.py threshold of $25 USDC minimum blocked Primary wallet which had only $5.24 USDC
files_modified: core/risk.py (always cap at USDC balance instead of ETH fallback)

patterns_extracted.description: EVM wallet env vars use WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME} not PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME}. Solana uses SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME}.
Most Base and Arbitrum tokens only have USDC liquidity on 1inch. Native ETH swaps return INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY. Always prefer USDC as buy-side capital on L2 chains.
DailyFloorGuardian persists to disk. After large drawdowns or position closures, the floor can be stale and block all trading. Reset via force_set_floor() when deploying fresh capital.
When USDC balance doesn't cover full Kelly-sized position, cap at 90% of available USDC rather than falling back to native ETH. This ensures trades execute even with smaller capital.

bottlenecks: Serial outer scoring loop (30-60 tokens × 10-23s each)
enrich_candidate() makes 6-7 sequential Moralis API calls per token
DexScreener 1-second rate limit per call (batch endpoint exists but unused)
Grok LLM calls add 1-3s per token
recommended_optimizations: Parallelize outer scoring loop with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5-10)
Use DexScreener batch endpoint (already implemented, never called in scan loop)
Cap Grok calls to top 5-10 candidates per cycle
